scope: Deadline audit of the supplementary prior-model benchmark; preserve every v1 artifact
already_disclosed: All original and supplementary v1 test scores have been viewed. Audit reruns are descriptive, not a new blind test.
neuralpower_revision: Fit the StandardScaler separately within each inner training fold. Reuse the original outer-train-derived 100-alpha grid and raw-MSE selection. Freeze validation selection before rerun test scoring.
neuralpower_preserved: Original polynomial map, train group subsets, seeds, alpha endpoints, loss, convergence tolerances, full refit scaler, and train-min latency floor; retain 0.105 ms floor sensitivity.
fair_comparison: Use k=200 shared three-layer training pool for local direct, NeuralPower, and GEMMify; choose each existing direct learner by validation only. Original frozen overall methods are reported separately with shared source/component-label costs.
external_source_check: Run pinned NeuSight pretrained weights on the authors' public LINEAR/BMM/GELU test measurements and original device profiles; report all available devices, including failures. These checks address source-domain execution, not reproduction of the whole-network headline.
other_methods: Audit GEMMify equations and literal grid against original paper; audit Paleo original FLOP/memory forward path and device units. Preserve existing outputs unless a concrete discrepancy is found.
source_model_cost: Keep local target labels, shared GEMM calibration/source training and external pretrained cost separate.
author_baseline_reproduction_status: Report fidelity by component, rather than treating a successful execution as validation of a published score.
